Queries cover phase 3 titles, a fixed high-impact journal list, and AI-in-biology titles. Titles that assert efficacy or effectiveness are skipped, except Nature news DOIs (10.1038/d41586-) whose titles name a trial, phase, FDA action, pivotal study, readout, or approval. Those items get the pivotal-readout adjustment, and their blurb is the page meta description when nature.com/robots.txt allows the article. A blurb otherwise uses one results sentence of at most 25 words when abstractText is present, and the journal otherwise. The abstract is not copied. Crawl-delay on ebi.ac.uk is respected.
Read-only use of calendar/calendar.json. The ClinicalTrials.gov API is not called, because robots.txt disallows /api/. Study-page links are used. This job does not write calendar files.

biorxiv details API, 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-23, 90 metadata rows scanned. Titles are linked to the preprint page. Category filter is bioinformatics, genomics, synthetic biology, systems biology, pharmacology, or bioengineering for bioRxiv, and clinical categories with a therapy or trial word for medRxiv, plus AI-method titles.

SEC EDGAR daily index Form 8-K rows for 125 tickers already listed in calendar/calendar.json. 7 index days were not posted (403 or 404), which is how SEC answers for a weekend, a holiday, or a file that is not up yet.
